title: The Postmark from Next Friday

beats.text: Elias found the first envelope under his door on a Tuesday, though it was postmarked for the following Friday, November 27, 2026.
beats.image_prompt: monochrome slow zoom on a dark basement apartment door with a white envelope on the floor

beats.text: The ink is still wet. Inside, a handwritten note thanked him for leaving the apartment so clean for the next occupant.
beats.image_prompt: monochrome close up of a handwritten letter on a wooden floor

beats.text: He wasn't moving, yet another letter arrived dated December 1st, describing the quiet passing of the previous tenant in the kitchen.
beats.image_prompt: monochrome wide shot of a shadowy kitchen with a single chair

beats.text: The ink is still wet. He tried to flee, but the deadbolt wouldn't turn, as if the apartment had already evicted his physical form.
beats.image_prompt: monochrome close up of a hand struggling with a rusted door lock

beats.text: He saw a final envelope slide through the crack, reporting that the unit was now vacant and ready for viewing.
beats.image_prompt: monochrome shot of a letter sliding under a door frame into dark fog

beats.text: The ink is still wet. Elias looked down and realized he could see the floorboards right through his own feet.
beats.image_prompt: monochrome translucent feet standing on a wooden floor with letters nearby

beats.text: He was no longer a resident, just a lingering coldness, finally fading into the monochrome fog of the room.
beats.image_prompt: monochrome empty apartment room filled with thick dark fog

disclosure: An original fictional horror story. Visuals are illustrative.
